<thought>Using the observed m/z 114.06808 as the molecular ion (radical cation), the exact monoisotopic mass matches C6H10O2 (C = 72.0000, H = 10 × 1.007825 = 10.07825, O = 2 × 15.994915 = 31.98983; total = 114.06808). This formula gives an integer double‑bond equivalent (DBE = 2) and fits the isotopic pattern indicating ~6 carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H10O2</final_answer>
